verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an email-marketing SaaS like Moosend, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of exporting subscribers, campaigns or other data in open formats. The only data-related line says the account and data 'stay intact' after a trial, which is about data retention, not export or portability. Community posts about the end of the free plan do not address export, so they are not relevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
